import chess,time,sys
from arena import load_board
V=[0,100,320,335,510,1000,20000]
TT={};nodes=0;start=0;limit=90
# Evaluation: centralization, mobility, pawn structure, and king proximity.
def evaluate(b):
 s=0;phase=0
 for p in [2,3,4,5]: phase+=len(b.pieces(p,True))*[0,0,1,1,2,4][p]+len(b.pieces(p,False))*[0,0,1,1,2,4][p]
 phase=min(24,phase)/24
 for color in [True,False]:
  val=0;enemyking=b.king(not color); kf=chess.square_file(enemyking);kr=chess.square_rank(enemyking)
  pawns=b.pieces(1,color); epawns=b.pieces(1,not color)
  for p in range(1,7):
   squares=b.pieces(p,color)
   if p==3 and len(squares)>1: val+=30
   for sq in squares:
    f=chess.square_file(sq);r=chess.square_rank(sq);rr=r if color else 7-r
    center=3.5-abs(f-3.5); centerr=3.5-abs(r-3.5)
    v=V[p]
    if p==1:
     v+=rr*5+center*3
     if f in [3,4]:v+=rr*3
     if not any(abs(chess.square_file(x)-f)==1 for x in pawns):v-=13
     if any(chess.square_file(x)==f and x!=sq for x in pawns):v-=12
     if not any(abs(chess.square_file(x)-f)<=1 and (chess.square_rank(x)>r if color else chess.square_rank(x)<r) for x in epawns):v+=rr*rr*3*(1.3-phase)
    elif p==2:
     v+=12*(center+centerr)-42
     if rr==0:v-=15
    elif p==3:v+=5*(center+centerr)-15
    elif p==4:
     if rr==6:v+=22
     if not any(chess.square_file(x)==f for x in pawns):v+=12
    elif p==5:v+=2*(center+centerr)
    elif p==6:v+=(1-phase)*(center+centerr)*12-phase*(rr*8+center*6)
    if p in [2,3,4,5]:
     attacks=b.attacks(sq);mob=len(attacks & ~b.occupied_co[color]);v+=mob*(2 if p!=5 else 1)
     # count attacks near opposing king
     near=sum(1 for x in attacks if abs(chess.square_file(x)-kf)<=1 and abs(chess.square_rank(x)-kr)<=1)
     v+=near*(7 if p!=5 else 12)*phase
    val+=v
  s+=val if color else -val
 return s if b.turn else -s

def order(b,m,tt):
 if m==tt:return 100000
 s=0
 if b.is_capture(m):
  cap=b.piece_type_at(m.to_square) or 1;s=10000+V[cap]*10-V[b.piece_type_at(m.from_square)]
 if m.promotion:s+=V[m.promotion]*10
 return s

def qsearch(b,a,be,ply=0):
 global nodes
 nodes+=1
 if nodes%2048==0 and time.time()-start>limit:raise TimeoutError
 check=b.is_check()
 if not check:
  v=evaluate(b)
  if v>=be:return v
  if v>a:a=v
 if ply>10:return evaluate(b)
 moves=list(b.legal_moves) if check else list(b.generate_legal_captures())
 if not moves and check:return -30000+ply
 for m in sorted(moves,key=lambda m:order(b,m,None),reverse=True):
  if not check and not m.promotion:
   cap=b.piece_type_at(m.to_square) or 1
   if v+V[cap]+180<a:continue
  b.push(m);v2=-qsearch(b,-be,-a,ply+1);b.pop()
  if v2>=be:return v2
  if v2>a:a=v2
 return a

def search(b,d,a,be,ply=0):
 global nodes
 nodes+=1
 if nodes%2048==0 and time.time()-start>limit:raise TimeoutError
 if b.is_repetition(2) or b.halfmove_clock>=100:return 0
 if d<=0:return qsearch(b,a,be)
 key=b._transposition_key();entry=TT.get(key);tt=entry[3] if entry else None;orig=a
 if entry and entry[0]>=d:
  val,flag=entry[1:3]
  if flag==0 or flag==1 and val>=be or flag==-1 and val<=a:return val
 moves=list(b.legal_moves)
 if not moves:return -30000+ply if b.is_check() else 0
 best=-40000;bm=None
 for i,m in enumerate(sorted(moves,key=lambda m:order(b,m,tt),reverse=True)):
  b.push(m)
  if i==0:v=-search(b,d-1,-be,-a,ply+1)
  else:
   v=-search(b,d-1,-a-1,-a,ply+1)
   if a<v<be:v=-search(b,d-1,-be,-a,ply+1)
  b.pop()
  if v>best:best=v;bm=m
  if v>a:a=v
  if a>=be:break
 TT[key]=(d,best,1 if best>=be else -1 if best<=orig else 0,bm)
 return best

def pv(b):
 b=b.copy();out=[]
 for i in range(12):
  e=TT.get(b._transposition_key())
  if not e or e[3] not in b.legal_moves:break
  m=e[3];out.append(b.san(m));b.push(m)
 return ' '.join(out)

if __name__=='__main__':
 b=load_board();limit=float(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 90
 if len(sys.argv)>2:
  for u in sys.argv[2:]:b.push_uci(u)
 print(b.fen(),flush=True);start=time.time()
 for d in range(1,12):
  try:
   v=search(b,d,-40000,40000);print(d,v,pv(b),'nodes',nodes,'time',round(time.time()-start,1),flush=True)
  except TimeoutError:break
